0022600036.text: The Heat come in at 4-6 and eighth in the East, second in the Southeast two games back, with a 1-3 home record and a one-game winning streak. The Cavaliers are 5-6 and seventh in the East, two and a half games back in the Central, and have lost their last two games, while Sam Merrill is out with an elbow injury. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not met yet this season, with the most recent meeting a 149-128 Cleveland win in Cleveland on March 27.
